risk_description: A forecast is produced from stale input
consequence: The analyst sees an obsolete estimate
control_description: Validate the newest observation is at most eight days old and fail closed

risk_description: An analyst treats the estimate as guaranteed
consequence: Planning over-relies on an uncertain output
control_description: Show uncertainty source date model version and the human-review advisory on every report

risk_description: The released forecast cannot be reproduced
cause: Uncontrolled data model code or configuration
consequence: Evidence cannot be tied to the operational output
control_description: Pin the complete baseline in MANIFEST-001 and compare deterministic output digests
